poses.label: Rack
poses.description: Hold the bar at your upper chest and brace your stomach and glutes.

poses.label: Face level
poses.description: Move your head slightly back and press the bar past your face.

poses.label: Clear head
poses.description: Once the bar clears your head, press it back into line over your shoulders.

poses.label: Overhead
poses.description: Finish with arms long overhead and ribs stacked over your hips.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower the bar under control, keeping it clear of your head.

poses.label: Return
poses.description: Bring the bar past your face and back to your upper chest.

checks: Braced standing start at the upper chest, clearance in front of the face and finish overhead without back lean.
Compared pose captions with the exact built-in exercise cue.
Checked camera bounds, equipment anchoring, and contact throughout the interpolated loop.
limitations: The rig has a fixed head. The bar travels forward to clear the face, and the caption explains the small head movement.
The simplified figure and fixed camera show the main movement path. In-app phone playback and admin review are pending.
The fixed camera and full-size plates can partially obscure the hands or bar.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js.
